embed.title: !untrack
embed.description: Remove pokemon tracking rules from your current profile. `{{prefix}}track remove ...` does the same thing. Start with a type name to remove other kinds of rules.

fields.name: Pokemon rules
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}untrack pikachu` — remove every pikachu rule
`{{prefix}}untrack pikachu charmander` — several at once
`{{prefix}}untrack everything` — remove all your pokemon rules
`{{prefix}}untrack id:45` — remove one pokemon rule by the id shown in `{{prefix}}tracked`

fields.name: By generation, type or costume
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}untrack gen:1` — remove rules for any Kanto pokemon
`{{prefix}}untrack dragon` — remove rules for any Dragon-type pokemon (type names are bare words)
`{{prefix}}untrack pikachu costume:holiday` — only the rules with that costume

This picks rules by the pokemon they name, not by the filters on them.

fields.name: Other tracking types
fields.value:
Put the type first: `raid`, `egg`, `quest`, `invasion`, `incident`, `lure`, `nest`, `gym`, `fort` or `maxbattle`.
`{{prefix}}untrack raid id:12` — one raid rule by id
`{{prefix}}untrack egg level:5`
`{{prefix}}untrack raid everything`

This is the same as `{{prefix}}raid remove id:12`, `{{prefix}}egg remove level:5` and so on. A bare `{{prefix}}untrack id:N` only looks at pokemon rules, because each type numbers its rules separately.

fields.name: Pause instead of remove
fields.value: `{{prefix}}mute pikachu duration:2h` silences alerts for a while without deleting anything (`{{prefix}}help mute`).
